summary: Delivery Service backend fully tested — 51/51 tests passed. All features verified: store seeding, webhook processing (orders/paid & orders/cancelled), idempotency, state machine full lifecycle (pending_assignment→assigned→at_store→in_transit→arrived→delivered), terminal state guards (409), invalid transition guards (409), IN_TRANSIT cancel guard (warning event, not cancelled), cancel endpoint, job detail fields, status filtering, existing Shopify endpoints regression, and HMAC verification logic.
critical_code_review_comments: hmac.new() in verification.py should be hmac.new() — actually it's Python's hmac.new which is correct (not a bug, just noting it works fine)
SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is intentionally empty in dev — signature verification is skipped. Must be set before production deployment.
Delivery router has several TODO: Restrict to admin JWT comments — auth is not applied yet on admin endpoints (intentional for this iteration)
seed_data_creation: Test delivery jobs created via webhook payloads during testing (prefixed with #TEST-). These remain in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delivery Service is fully implemented and tested. State machine, webhook processing, idempotency, and all edge cases verified. Next iteration may add Rider App auth or Admin Dashboard auth on the currently unauthenticated delivery endpoints.
